purpose: Prospectively evaluate one unified Quick Evidence candidate that layers bounded, source-backed evidence on top of the serving Quick member probabilities without changing serving traffic.

supersession.reason: The earlier availability-only protocol was replaced before activation by the unified Quick Evidence candidate requested for a single evidence system.

activeEvidence: bill-specific direct statements from verified member-controlled sources extracted by deterministic exact-bill rules
bill-specific related statements that satisfy the Quick Evidence candidate policy
existing bill-specific directional evidence that already passes the evidence impact policy
official prior passage votes on the same bill or companion bill strictly before the forecast date
recordedButZeroWeightUntilSeparateValida: prior same-bill other recorded YEA/NAY counts
forbiddenAutomaticInferences: donor or lobbyist relationship implies stance
campaign-finance amount implies support or opposition
LLM-generated stance without source-backed deterministic or separately validated extraction

capture.unit: member prediction within an immutable Quick revision
capture.timing: immediately after the serving Quick revision is persisted
capture.sourceCutoff: all durable evidence must have source_documents.fetched_at less than or equal to the forecast as-of timestamp; published_at, when present, must also be no later than the as-of timestamp

requiredComparisons: serving Quick versus Quick Evidence on all eligible resolved member outcomes
serving Quick versus Quick Evidence on members whose candidate probability actually moved
performance sliced by evidence type, chamber, party, source quality, conflict status, and evidence freshness

amendment.reason: Before any 2027-2028 Quick revision existed, add historically reconstructable prior same-bill non-passage vote counts to the unified feature vector at zero weight pending validation.
